subject: Solution orchestration: technical alignment + marketplace SI workshop
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
To: Devon Hale <devon@aperture.io>, Priya Menon <priya@cloudhub.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Solution orchestration: proposed technical deep-dive + marketplace SI workshop

Hi Devon & Priya,

Thanks again for agreeing to run a joint technical session next week to align on the integration flow for the CloudHub marketplace listing and the Aperture SI deployment pattern. Objective: confirm end-to-end request routing, auth/KMS expectations, and a proposed rollout/test plan so both teams can estimate work and timelines.

Proposed agenda (60–75 min):
- 5 min intros & goals
- 15 min architecture overview (Redwood + Aperture integration points)
- 25 min deep-dive on auth, KV cache handling, and network topology (VPC peering / private link options)
- 10 min rollout & verification plan (canary, fallback model)
- 10 min action items & next steps

I attached a rough solution diagram and a checklist for deployment items. Can you confirm availability for one of these slots (PST):
- Tue Dec 8, 10:00–11:15
- Wed Dec 9, 13:00–14:15
- Thu Dec 10, 08:30–09:45

If none of these work, share two windows that work for your engineering and product leads.

Attachments: solution-arch-diagram.pdf (1.2MB)

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.ai

From: Devon Hale <devon@aperture.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Cc: eng-team@aperture.io, Priya Menon <priya@cloudhub.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Solution orchestration: proposed technical deep-dive + marketplace SI workshop

Markus — thanks for the clear agenda. Aperture is excited to move this forward. Quick notes on availability: the Wed/Thu slots are tight for our lead infra engineer, Alex (cc'd on eng-team), because they're in EMEA travel that week. The Tue Dec 8 10:00–11:15 PST slot should work for product + solutions, but Alex can only join 10:30–11:15 PST.

We have two asks before the call:
1) Can you send a brief pre-read (1 page) that lists the auth flows you expect (API key vs. federated/assumed role) and whether Redwood will present any KMS/HSM constraints?
2) Can you confirm if the diagram attached contains the expected traffic flow between the marketplace, Redwood hosted inference, and the Aperture SI-managed GPU cluster?

If Tue is confirmed we'll join 10:00 with product and solutions; Alex will dial in at 10:30 for the infra deep-dive.

Cheers,
Devon Hale
Director of Integrations
Aperture Integrations
devon@aperture.io

Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Solution orchestration: proposed technical deep-dive + marketplace SI workshop

Thanks Devon — Tue Dec 8 at 10:00 PST is confirmed on our side. I've created a calendar invite for 10:00–11:15 PST (attached as calendar-invite.ics) and added a short pre-read (two bullets) below and in the shared drive link. Alex can join at 10:30 for the infra portion — we'll sequence auth and topology first so infra can jump in when needed.

Pre-read (one page):
- Auth: Redwood supports API-key and OAuth 2.0 with client credentials; for private deployments we recommend cross-account role assumption backed by KMS envelope encryption. If you require HSM-backed keys, note there are latency and rotation implications.
- Traffic topology: Marketplace -> Redwood API (edge) -> model routing -> optional private egress to Aperture's SI cluster (mutual TLS + VPC peering or PrivateLink). KV cache remains on Redwood side; we can configure a short-lived shard exchange for locality-sensitive workloads.

Attached: RA-deployment-checklist.xlsx (stub) and calendar-invite.ics

Looking forward — agenda and invite in the calendar. If Priya needs a separate CloudHub procurement presence, please loop them in.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai

I'll circulate a short internal pre-read and connect Alex to the invite link.
